name: Sissy Squat
research: 12 Nov 2026 fix. Two causes of the failed end picture: (1) pipeline bug: MPFB bones are XYZ-euler but the bake keyed only the root's rotation_quaternion, so the root's lean was never keyed and every frame showed the LAST pose's lean (0): the end stood upright with the hips bent instead of leaning back 40. animate.bake now keys the channel in use. (2) feet: the rig's toes do not bend, so the lowest point is the toe tip, not the ball. Toe tip sits (0,-0.196,-0.074) from the ankle in the rest foot (fitted to three cloud floor readings: sissy -0.0356 m at rot 40/z 0.147, calf raise 0.1185 and 0.0902). Foot rot X 30 (heel up): toe = ankle + (0,-0.133,-0.162) -> ankle z 0.163 puts the toe tip at z 0.001; heel z 0.127 (clearly up). Ankle (0.12,-0.085,0.163) both pictures, toe tip y -0.218. START: root (0,-0.019,1.062), hip-ankle 0.90 m, knee ~11 deg (soft). END: root (0,-0.154,0.682) rot X -40 -> hip L (0.11,-0.191,0.717); knee (0.118,-0.485,0.367); knee flexion 103, hip flexion 1 (thigh and trunk one line leaning back 40), shin 63 deg forward. Shoulders y +0.09 = 31 cm behind the knees, toes at -0.22. Arms elev 50 in the torso frame = level with the floor when leaning back 40. Neck/head 18/12 forward so he looks ahead.
